title: Stay Alive
tagline: The wonderful blockchain game~ Looking forward to the day it goes live.
description: The game will become more refined in the future. Due to time constraints, the on-chain implementation of the game logic is not ideal. A significant amount of time was spent on enhancing the game's graphics in the early stages. Hopefully, the visual effects after the on-chain implementation will match those seen in the videos!
how_its_made: This project uses the Unity engine in combination with the Dojo Engine, and employs programming languages such as Cairo and C#. Of course, I also searched for many free assets in the Unity Store. The Cairo language is used for writing game logic, and the experience is quite good. Personally, I find it more comfortable than using Solidity for writing fully on-chain games.
